lastCompletedStory.title: Container git HTTPS + token credential configuration (no ~/.ssh, no host cred file)

nextStoryContext: US-001, US-002, US-003 are complete. US-004 is the DNS-based firewall rewrite for init-firewall.sh: replace the current dig+ipset static resolution with a dnsmasq + ipset dynamic approach, and fix the LFS host (objects.githubusercontent.com or similar). The init-firewall.sh currently uses dig to resolve IPs at startup into an ipset; US-004 rewrites this to use dnsmasq for live DNS interception. The .devcontainer/ directory is NOT embedded/vendored so no embed-vendor step needed. Key constraint: the firewall self-verify (api.anthropic.com reachable, example.com blocked) must still pass after the rewrite.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Carried from US-001/US-002: name-only -e VARNAME form confirmed. Implementation is correct.

Git credential helper protocol confirmed: helper outputs key=value pairs (username, password) on stdout. x-access-token as username with GITHUB_TOKEN as password is correct for GitHub HTTPS PAT auth. credential.https://github.com.helper scoping is valid and restricts the helper to github.com HTTPS only.
